grade3_ela_proficient.label: Third graders reading at grade level (proficient or above on the state English test)
grade3_ela_proficient.source: Ohio Department of Education and Workforce, school report card data; NCES Common Core of Data for weights
grade3_ela_proficient.note: Share of tested third graders who scored proficient or above on Ohio's third grade English test. County figures combine public school districts and in-person community schools, weighted by grade 3 enrollment; schools too small for ODEW to report are left out. Fewer students tested in 2020-2021. The Ohio figure is built the same way from all districts and schools so counties compare on equal terms; ODEW's published state figure is lower (63.4% in 2025-2026), most likely because it also counts students who are not in any one district's or school's result.
